Call Recording product marketing vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Call Recording capability in the binary covers storefront language. Recording behavior and Connect actually separate call capture from product-page copy:

  • Call Recording & transcript UX — configured in your app so answered calls can be recorded, saved, played back, or converted to searchable text on device. Controls in-app recording behavior. Does not generate Chinese listing text.
  • Saved-call library & transcript views — in-app UI showing recorded conversations, playback scrubbers, and transcript paragraphs. Your listing may mention 通话录音; building those views is product work, not Connect metadata.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of recording flags in the binary.

Working call recording in the binary and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other.

Call Recording listing copy is not Call Screening, Live Voicemail, Hold Assist, Silence Unknown Callers, or CallKit

Phone and productivity apps blur six surfaces indie teams conflate. AppLocale covers listing metadata only — layer 1.

  • Call Recording & on-device transcripts (this page) — recording answered phone calls, saved-call libraries, transcript text views, and description copy about turning recordings into searchable 通话记录文本 on the product page.
  • Call Screening (different) — unknown-caller reason flows and screen-before-you-answer marketing. See Call Screening listing guide — not recording-after-answer copy.
  • Live Voicemail (different) — real-time voicemail transcription while the caller leaves a message. See Live Voicemail listing guide — not recording an answered conversation.
  • Silence Unknown Callers (different) — system setting that sends unknown numbers straight to voicemail or silences the ring. Not call recording marketing unless your gallery explicitly shows recording UX.
  • Hold Assist (different) — wait-on-hold automation and staying on hold for the user. See Hold Assist listing guide — not 通话录音 or transcript overlays.
  • CallKit native call UI (different) — VoIP incoming-call screens that look like Phone.app. See CallKit listing guide — not recording storefront copy.

Your screenshots may show multiple surfaces in one gallery. Listing copy should name the correct one per frame — a saved-call transcript view is not a Live Voicemail line, not a Call Screening reason card, and not a Hold Assist queue timer.

Common mistakes on Call Recording zh-Hans listings

  • Assuming recording support localizes automatically — Call Recording wired in the product; zh-Hans row never added or left blank
  • Only translating the description — subtitle, keywords, and recording screenshot caption lines still English
  • Conflating recording with Live Voicemail — voicemail transcription while they leave a message is not recording an answered call; see Live Voicemail listing guide
  • Conflating recording with Call Screening — 来电筛选 is not 通话录音; screening before pickup and recording after answer are different buyer stories
  • Conflating recording with Hold Assist — wait-on-hold automation is not call recording marketing; see Hold Assist listing guide
  • Claiming universal carrier recording — 全网通话录音 or 运营商录音 overclaims when the app records in-app sessions or supported paths only
  • English "Call Recording" on zh-Hans screenshots — Connect caption fields are Chinese but burned-in recording mockups on PNG exports are still Latin
  • Expecting AppLocale to build recording or transcription features — recording pipelines and transcript engines are outside listing rewrite
